32017-(R1884).s: The bill establishes a single Joint Court of Justice (Gemeenschappelijk Hof van Justitie) for Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba), with Courts of First Instance in each territory and a Court of Appeal, and regulates the appointment, discipline and dismissal of judges, the court's administration, a Beheerraad supervisory board, and budgeting. It largely carries over the existing Netherlands Antilles/Aruba judicial structure into the new constitutional arrangement of the Kingdom.
32017-(R1884).j: The memorandum justifies the structure by small scale of the islands, the need for one court with personal union of judges, and continuity with the existing Netherlands Antilles/Aruba system; delegations are justified as technical detail.
q: The Court and the Courts of First Instance form one organisation.
Het Hof en de Gerechten vormen één organisatie.
d: designation of universities and equivalent diplomas for judicial appointment eligibility
rules on dismissal, suspension and remuneration of Beheerraad members
rules on financing of the court and cost-sharing key among the territories
allocation of judicial work among judges by the court board
appointment of judges-substitute in first instance via royal decree on joint ministerial proposal
p: Court administration and staff are centralised in a single body rather than in each territory's ministry, reducing territorial control over the judicial apparatus.
Ministers of Justience of the four territories jointly set the court's budget amount, with the Beheerraad budget subject to ministerial approval.

parties: Objects to the legal basis and to bypassing the island parliaments on the court's budget key and the judicial organisation, and demands a right of withdrawal.
Article 17(3) provides that the Court or its members further perform the tasks assigned to them by national ordinance or law.
Het derde lid van artikel 17 bepaalt dat het Hof of de leden voorts de hun bij landsverordening of wet opgedragen taken vervullen.
Warns the bill infringes island autonomy and raises concerns about the self-determination of Bonaire's population if the referendum rejects the package.
The independent member Nicolaas has further substantive comments on the bill before us.
Het onafhankelijke lid Nicolaas heeft verder enkele inhoudelijke opmerkingen ten aanzien van het voorliggende voorstel van rijkswet.
Rejects unilateral imposition of measures on Aruba and demands clarity on what the safeguard article protects and on the seat question.
Unilaterally and forcefully imposing plans or measures is not in keeping with the spirit of the Statute.
Het eenzijdig en dwingend opleggen van plannen of maatregelen is niet in overeenstemming met de geest van het Statuut.
Supports the bill as a negotiated result but asks for an interim evaluation after two and a half years and for budget and judgment transparency to parliaments.
In the PAR fraction's view it should be possible to add to that article an interim evaluation after two and a half years.
Naar het oordeel van de PAR-fractie moet het mogelijk zijn om in bovenaangehaald artikel tevens op te nemen dat na tweeëneenhalf jaar een tussentijdse evaluatie zal plaatsvinden.
Shares the PAR call for an interim evaluation of the bill.
The UPB fraction also shares that position.
Ook de UPB-fractie deelt overigens dat standpunt.
Asks that the Raad van State's advice on disclosure of rulings, secrecy duties and the age limit be taken over more fully.
In the PNP fraction's view it may be wise to look very critically again at what the Council of State of the Kingdom and the Advisory Council have advised.

Naar het oordeel van de PNP-fractie is het wellicht verstandig indien alsnog zeer kritisch wordt gekeken naar hetgeen de Raad van State van het Koninkrijk en ook de Raad van Advies hebben geadviseerd.
Asks whether the three-instance structure of the Joint Court conflicts with the impartiality requirement of Article 6 ECHR and what measures will remove that tension.
This assessment of a dispute in three instances by one and the same organisation is at odds with the objective impartiality of Article 6 of the European Convention on Human Rights.

Deze beoordeling in drie instanties van een geschil door één en dezelfde organisatie staat op gespannen voet met de objectieve onpartijdigheid van artikel 6 van het Europees Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden (EVRM).
Questions whether granting Aruba its own first-instance court and registry separate from the Joint Court endangers judicial independence and whether Article 43 is being misused as legal basis.
Does the government share the view of these members that leaving the judicial organisation to Aruba separately from the Joint Court would harm the independence of the judiciary?

Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat met het mogelijke overlaten van de rechterlijke organisatie aan Aruba los van de samenwerking in het Gemeenschappelijk Hof van Justitie afbreuk zal worden gedaan aan de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtspraak?
Worries that judges who ruled at first instance may still discuss cases with appeal judges given the intertwined organisation, and asks about lay judges and dismissal grounds.
This entails risks, according to the members of the SP faction.
Dit brengt risico's met zich mee, zo menen de leden van de SP-fractie.

Asks for clarity on the registry organisation, the escalation procedure if the four ministers do not agree, and why incompatibility rules and a register of side positions do not apply to substitute judges.
On what grounds is there no register for members of the Court as referred to in Article 44(3) of the Judicial Officers Legal Status Act?
Op grond van welke overwegingen is voor leden van het Hof niet voorzien in een register als bedoeld in artikel 44, derde lid, Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren.
Asks why the government did not follow the Council of State's advice on the seat issue, what follows if Aruba refuses to co-sign, and whether the age-65 dismissal rule is too rigid.
The members of the ChristenUnie faction request the government to explain this choice.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie verzoeken de regering deze keuze toe te lichten.
Questions whether the Beheerraad is necessary given its limited tasks and objects to the chair being elected by its own members rather than appointed by the minister.
These members are not in favour of the chair of the Beheerraad being chosen by the members of that council themselves.
Deze leden zijn geen voorstander van het feit dat de voorzitter van de Beheerraad door de leden van die raad zelf wordt gekozen.

Objects that the Kingdom's use of article 43(2) of the Statuut makes the matter a Kingdom affair and blocks the consensus route, and argues the Raad van State advice and Aruban positions should be respected.

The A.V.P. faction notes that because the Netherlands used the statutory bases of article 43(2) in conjunction with article 14 of the Statuut, the Netherlands made this subject a Kingdom affair and thereby blocked the route to a consensus rijkswet for Aruba.

De A.V.P.-fractie merkt ter zake op dat door het feit dat Nederland de statutaire grondslagen volgens artikel 43, tweede lid, jo artikel 14 van het Statuut gebruikt heeft, Nederland dit onderwerp tot een Koninkrijksaangelegenhe id heeft gemaakt en daarmee de weg naar een consensusrijkswet heeft geblokkeerd, voor wat betreft het land Aruba.

Argues the Kingdom Council of Ministers acted contrary to the Statuut by using article 43(2), that rechtshandhaving is an autonomous Aruban matter, requests an appeal body for the colleges van beroep, and questions the process by which judges' legal positions were set outside the regular track.
The M.E.P. faction holds that law enforcement is an autonomous affair of Aruba, and that there has never been objection to regulating it under article 38 of the Statuut.

De M.E.P.-fractie is de mening toegedaan dat rechtshandhaving een autonome aangelegenheid is van Aruba, terwijl tegen het regelen ervan conform artikel 38, van het Statuut nimmer bezwaar heeft bestaan.
Asks why the bill pays no particular attention to fiscal legal protection for taxpayers, which it says falls short of international treaty standards such as article 14(5) of the ICCPR.
It is of eminent importance that fiscal legal protection in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom be raised to a level comparable with Europe.
Het is immers van eminent belang dat de fiscale rechtsbescherming in het Caraïbische gedeelte van het Koninkrijk naar een vergelijkbaar niveau wordt getild als in het Europese.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State of the Kingdom advised that the draft Rijkswet on the Joint Court of Justice rest solely on Article 38(2) of the Statute, that a fallback for designating the seat of the Court be added, and made several points on the Beheerraad composition, confidentiality, age limit, oath formula, and secondary rules. The government's reply largely accepts the advice on the basis, the Beheerraad hearing of the Court board, confidentiality and the age limit, but keeps Aruba's seat on Article 43(2) and rejects the proposal to add judges to the Beheerraad.
concerns: The Raad advised that the Beheerraad, which oversees the judiciary, should operate with a trust relationship with the Court, so the Court board must be heard on appointments, which the government adopted; the Raad's wish for judicial representation on the Beheerraad was rejected.
The Raad stated that publication of judgments cannot be satisfied by merely sending copies, citing Article 6 ECHR, and asked the explanatory memorandum to be amended, which the government did.

The Raad advised basing the entire Rijkswet on Article 38(2) with a fallback to Article 43(2) for the seat, but the government kept Article 43(2) for Aruba, arguing judicial independence requires a joint court.
The Raad advised extending the confidentiality duty of Article 12 to lay judges, which was adopted.

The Raad asked for justification of the age limit of 65 and the removal of the oath formula's duplicated passage, and for a basis for rules on court costs; the government adjusted the age-limit basis and added a regulatory power for court costs, while rejecting the oath change.

32256-(R1906).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2005 London Protocols amending the Suppression of Unlawful Acts (SUA) Convention on maritime safety and the protocol on fixed platforms on the continental shelf. The protocols extend criminal offences to transport of weapons of mass destruction and dual-use goods, and allow boarding of foreign-flagged ships on the high seas with flag-state consent.
32256-(R1906).j: The memorandum justifies the boarding powers by the treaty requirement that states ensure officials have the necessary powers, and notes that flag-state consent is the strict starting point.
q: The strict starting point is that explicit consent of the flag state is required for this.
Strikt uitgangspunt is dat hiervoor de expliciete toestemming van de vlaggenstaat is vereist.
p: Memorie van toelichting, art. 8 (new art. 8bis SUA)
Dutch naval commanders gain powers to board foreign-flagged ships on the high seas, conditional on flag-state consent and implemented via Title VIA of the Criminal Procedure Code.

parties: Supports broader anti-terrorism instruments and asks whether piracy cases in the Gulf of Aden fall under the new provisions.
These members support the aim of broader anti-terrorism instruments.
Deze leden onderschrijven het streven naar ruimere antiterrorisme-instrumenten.
Asks for analysis of risks from the boarding procedure, including sovereignty infringements and whether flag-state consent in advance is needed.
Please provide an extensive analysis of possible risks of this provision.
Graag een uitgebreide analyse van mogelijke risico's aan deze bepaling.
Can agree with the anti-terrorism measures but asks the government to explain the liability regime for damage from wrongful or unreasonable boarding measures.
These members further request the government to explain precisely what the liability arrangement for damage caused by wrongful or unreasonable measures in boarding entails.
Voornoemde leden verzoeken de regering verder aan te geven wat de regeling van de aansprakelijkheid voor schade door onterechte of onredelijke maatregelen in het kader van «boarding» precies inhoudt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised supporting the 2005 IMO protocols against maritime and fixed-platform terrorism, but asked that the protocols apply across the whole Kingdom and that the explanatory memorandum clarify timing of implementing legislation for the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba. The government's reply states the memorandum was supplemented to note Aruba's wish to be covered by the protocols.
concerns: The Raad advised promoting extension of the protocols to all Kingdom countries and stating when implementing legislation is expected, which the government addressed by supplementing the memorandum on Aruba's position.

32309-(R1907).s: The bill amends the Passport Act to allow the minister, on notice from a friendly foreign authority, to refuse or revoke a travel document where there is a well-founded suspicion the person will evade prosecution or sentence abroad for an offence carrying at least one year's imprisonment. It also lets municipalities charge different fees for non-residents when issuing passports.
32309-(R1907).j: The memorandum justifies the new ground by the state's need to prevent flight from foreign criminal justice and by the costs of issuing documents to non-residents that the existing fee cannot cover.
q: Under the proposed text of Article 23a, refusal or revocation of a travel document may occur if, following a notice from a competent authority of a friendly power, there is a 'well-founded suspicion' that the person will evade prosecution or sentence there.

Ingevolge de voorgestelde tekst van artikel 23a kan weigering of vervallenverklaring van een reisdocument geschieden, indien naar aanleiding van een daarop betrekking hebbende kennisgeving door een bevoegde autoriteit van een met het Koninkrijk bevriende mogendheid het«gegronde vermoeden» bestaat
d: refusal or revocation of travel document on request of minister
differentiated passport fees for non-residents set by municipalities within maximum
p: Allows the minister to refuse or revoke a passport based on a foreign authority's notice and a well-founded suspicion of flight from prosecution, a discretionary power that reduces citizens' protection against the state.

parties: Supports the refusal power but stresses that it is discretionary and requires a person-specific assessment, and asks how Dutch citizens in semi-libertad in Latin American countries are protected.
They also think it is good that it is a discretionary provision, so there is no obligation to refuse or invalidate the document.
Zij vinden het ook goed dat het een kan-bepaling is, zodat er geen verplichting is te weigeren of het document vervallen te verklaren.
Welcomes the new ground but asks what criteria apply to judge whether foreign legal proceedings are careless and how health is assessed.
When is a legal process in the country in question careless?
Wanneer is een rechtsgang in het desbetreffende land onzorgvuldig?
Supports the measure but argues it should apply to all offences rather than only those carrying a sentence of one year or more, and asks about criteria for health-based exceptions.

However, these members state that this should apply to all offences and suspicions of offences, and not only to suspicions of offences carrying a (maximum) prison sentence of one year or longer as this bill implies.

Wel stellen deze leden dat dit bij alle misdrijven en verdenkingen van misdrijven moet gelden en niet uitsluitend bij verdenkingen van misdrijven waarvoor een (maximale) vrijheidsstraf van een jaar of langer kan worden opgelegd zoals dit wetsvoorstel impliceert.

32360-XIV.s: This budget supplementary law (slotwet) adjusts the 2009 appropriations and receipts of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, including departmental articles and agency budgets. It also relaxes two reporting requirements of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for the ministry's 2009 annual report.
q: Notwithstanding Article 54(1) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, for the ministry's 2009 annual report the per-policy-article insight may be limited to parts c through f of that paragraph.

In afwijking van artikel 54, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 geldt voor het jaarverslag van het ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit voor het jaar 2009, dat het in dat artikellid bedoelde inzicht per beleidsartikel in de toelichting bij de verantwoordingsstaat beperkt kan blijven tot de onderdelen c tot en met f van dat artikellid.

32360-XVI.s: This bill sets the final budget adjustments (slotwetmutaties) for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for 2009, including appropriations, expenditures and receipts by article and agency. It also allows the ministry's 2009 annual report to depart from certain Comptabiliteitswet 2001 presentation requirements as part of a reporting experiment.
32360-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the reporting deviations as participation in a government experiment to improve accountability and budgeting, approved by the House of Representatives.
q: The experiment substantively concerns the following accountability aspects.
Het experiment heeft inhoudelijk betrekking op de volgende verantwoordingsaspecten.

32609-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by approving supplementary budget changes in euros for various policy articles. It also sets the unit of account in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date, with retroactive effect to 2 January if published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2011
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2011

32780-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, reallocating funds across policy articles. It also authorises a multi-year budget reserve to cover state guarantees for residual debts of education institutions that default on loans.
32780-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the reserve on administrative efficiency grounds, noting that a general statutory provision is planned in the revision of the Comptabiliteitswet until then the deviation will be repeated annually in the budget law.
q: From a standpoint of administrative efficiency it is not desirable to maintain five separate budget reserves charged to the relevant policy articles
Uit een oogpunt van administratieve doelmatigheid is het niet gewenst dat er vijf aparte begrotingsreserves worden aangehouden ten laste van de betrokken beleidsartikelen

33480-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) and its baten-lastendiensten (trading-fund agencies) through a second supplementary budget tied to the Autumn Memorandum. It changes appropriations and commitments across policy articles without shifting rule-making or oversight powers.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII), all for the year 2012
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII), alle voor het jaar 2012

33750-XIII.s: This bill fixes the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (expenditure, commitments and revenue by policy article) and the 2014 budget statements for its agencies, in thousands of euros, effective 1 January 2014. The explanatory memorandum sets out policy priorities for economy, energy, agriculture, education and nature, and budget figures for the ministry's agencies and regulators.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2014 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33776-(R2015).s: The bill repeals the Machtigingswet instelling visserijzone and amends the Visserijwet 1963, Visserijwet BES, the Uitvoeringswet Visserijverdrag 1967, the Rijkswet instelling exclusieve economische zone and the Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen so that the fisheries zone is defined by the territorial sea plus the exclusive economic zone. It updates references to the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba to the current constituent countries and public bodies, with some provisions taking effect retroactively from 10 October 2010.
33776-(R2015).j: The memorandum explains that the fisheries competences of the Kingdom can be exercised under the Rijkswet instelling exclusieve economische zone, so the fisheries zone concept is retained for familiarity and international use.
q: The Machtigingswet instelling visserijzone is repealed.
De Machtigingswet instelling visserijzone wordt ingetrokken.

33930-XIII.s: This bill (second supplementary budget law for 2013) amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and the agencies budget statement for 2013, following earlier budget laws. It sets out the changes in obligations, expenditure and receipts per policy and non-policy article, effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34085-VIII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2014 departmental expenditure statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII), adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across primary, secondary, vocational, higher and scientific education and other policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 December 2014 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
34085-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need to adjust the expenditure statement, including recovering funds after controls and carrying over commitments to later years.
q: Whereas We have considered that a change in the departmental expenditure statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2014 has proven necessary.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2014

34475-XV.s: This bill adjusts the 2015 budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and its agency, approving the supplementary and closing budget changes and setting the effective date retroactive to 31 December of the budget year. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: We have deemed it good and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2015 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd

35099-(R2114).s: The bill creates a procedure for resolving disputes between the Kingdom and the constituent countries (Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten) about interpretation of the Statute, by having the Advisory Division of the Council of State of the Kingdom give a non-binding opinion after failed continued consultation. The Council of Ministers then decides, not departing from the opinion without weighty grounds, and the opinion is published.
35099-(R2114).j: The memorandum justifies the procedure by the need to provide a neutral dispute mechanism for Caribbean countries and the many years since Article 12a of the Statute required arrangements.
q: The opinion does not bind the Council of Ministers of the Kingdom.
Het oordeel bindt de Rijksministerraad niet.
d: Chair of Council of Ministers may refuse dispute request for urgent decision-making
p: The chair of the Council of Ministers may refuse a country's request to have a dispute heard if a weighty Kingdom interest requires urgent decisions.
The Council of Ministers may depart from the advisory opinion for weighty grounds and must consider later facts, with reasons given for any departure.

parties: Argues the proposed dispute-settlement arrangement lets the Dutch side overrule rulings against it, making the Kingdom government judge and jury, and wants a joint motion and a Central Assembly.
The proposal currently on the table does not meet the three criteria the countries previously agreed on.
Het voorstel dat momenteel op tafel ligt, voldoet niet aan de drie criteria, waar de landen het in het Koninkrijk eerder mee eens waren.
Says a dispute mechanism must produce binding advice from an independent authority on strictly legal matters, which the proposal does not do; urges lobbying of Dutch parliamentarians.
An independent authority should be the one to issue rulings on a dispute.
Een onafhankelijke autoriteit zou degene moeten zijn die vonnissen over een geschil moet uitbrengen.
Notes the proposal does not meet the three elements in the Dutch parliamentary motion and fears adoption in the Tweede Kamer; urges contingency plans for existing disputes.
But it is now clear that what is about to be presented for approval by the Tweede Kamer does not meet those 3 elements.
Maar het is nu duidelijk dat wat op het punt staat te worden gepresenteerd als de optie voor goedkeuring door de Tweede Kamer, niet voldoet aan die 3 elementen.
The bill leaves final decisions with the Council of Ministers, a political body unsuited to resolving legal disputes, and calls for an independent judicial body with binding rulings.
A political body, i.e. the Council of Ministers, thus takes a final decision here.
Een politiek orgaan, i.e. de ministerraad, neemt hier aldus een eindbeslissing.
Dispute settlement must be entrusted to an independent judicial body, with binding decisions on constitutional questions, as Article 12a Statuut requires.
If one wishes to give substance to Article 12a Statuut, the arrangement must at least grant jurisdiction over constitutional legal disputes to an independent judicial body capable of binding rulings.

Wanneer men invulling wenst te geven aan artikel 12a Statuut dan dient de regeling ten minste een geschilbeslechtingsbevoegdheid van constitutionele, juridische geschillen te verlenen aan een onafhankelijke rechterlijke instantie die bindende uitspraken kan doen.
Without an independent judicial remedy against unlawful Kingdom action, the Caribbean countries face a structural legality deficit and erosion of trust.
the trust of the Countries in the Kingdom is structurally undermined if no adequate means of redress against unlawful Kingdom action is provided to them.
wordt het vertrouwen van de Landen in het Koninkrijk op structurele wijze ondermijnd indien er voor hen geen adequate redresmogelijkheid wordt gegeven tegen onrechtmatig Koninkrijkshandelen.
The bill formalises the Raad van State's advisory role, but the government can set aside its advice, so the advice carries no binding weight.
The draft lacks a binding ruling by an independent body and lets the RMR decide over the Raad van State's advice, weakening independent dispute settlement.
The present draft meets only one of those three principles; there is no binding ruling and no independent body that rules.
Het onderhavige ontwerp voldoet slechts aan één van die drie uitgangspunten; er is geen sprake van een bindende uitspraak en er is geen sprake van een onafhankelijke instantie die uitspraak doet.
The RMR appears unwilling to give up power, and the final decision remains with the RMR rather than an independent body.
The final decision on a dispute remains with the RMR.
De uiteindelijke beslissing over een geschil blijft bij de RMR.

Questions whether the Kingdom government is genuinely interested in a dispute mechanism, and asks why an independent chamber was not created; the RMR deciding disputes leaves little room for equality.
Why was it not chosen to set up the Council of State with an independent division dealing with dispute settlement?
Waarom is niet ervoor gekozen om de Raad van State met een onafhankelijke afdeling in te richten die zich met de geschillenbeslechting zou bezighouden?
Rejects the draft because it sets aside the agreed principles.
The PIN faction rejects the draft.
No equality while the RMR can itself decide a dispute; rejects the draft citing the Motie Van Laar principles.
According to the faction there is no equality as long as the RMR itself can decide on a dispute.
Volgens de fractie is er geen sprake van gelijkwaardigheid zolang de RMR zelf kan beslissen over een geschil.
Asks for clarification of what counts as a legal dispute, why the Afdeling advisering was chosen as dispute body, and what 'zwaarwegende gronden' allowing departure from its opinion means.
What is meant by legal disputes?
Wat wordt onder juridische geschillen verstaan?
Questions whether the scheme is truly independent, since the Rijksministerraad can set aside the advisory opinion on weighty grounds, and asks for more detail on that criterion.

Was a fully independent handling of disputes not envisaged at the time, and does the government share the view that the scheme is not fully independent, since the Rijksministerraad can set aside the advice?

Werd destijds niet gedacht aan een volledig onafhankelijke behandeling van geschillen en deelt de regering de mening, zoals die door verschillende deskundigen naar voren wordt gebracht, dat de thans voorziene regeling niet volledig onafhankelijk is

Objects that the chair of the Rijksministerraad can reject a dispute request, that the Rijksministerraad can depart from the advisory opinion on open-ended grounds, and that independence and impartiality are not secured; also that the bill departs from the Raad van State's advice.
These members ask the government to exhaustively list the weighty grounds it sees that could justify departing from the dispute body's opinion.
Zij vragen de regering uitputtend te benoemen welke zwaarwegende gronden zij ziet die aanleiding kunnen geven om van het oordeel van de geschilinstantie af te kunnen wijken.

Asks why a binding outcome was not chosen, notes that the scheme lacks support across all countries, and questions whether it respects autonomy and fair authority relations; calls for withdrawal of the bill.
Why has no heed been paid to the joint IPKO position that a Hoog College van Staat should be designated to give binding rulings on a Kingdom dispute?

Waarom is geen gehoor gegeven aan het door het IPKO gezamenlijk ingenomen standpunt dat een Hoog College van Staat zou moeten worden aangewezen om bindende oordelen te geven over een Koninkrijksgeschil?
Asks how the scheme would work in practice with a hypothetical case, and why the countries cannot agree on a joint scheme, including clarity of responsibilities.
When did the State Secretary last consult these countries about a joint bill, and why did that not succeed?
Wanneer heeft de Staatssecretaris voor het laatst met deze landen overlegd over een gezamenlijk wetsvoorstel en waarom is dat toen niet gelukt?

Argues that a truly independent arbiter not previously involved in drafting should decide, that the Rijksministerraad having the final word undermines independence, and that binding outcomes were requested by the Chamber via the Van Laar motion.
Do you consider a dispute scheme for disputes between the countries themselves desirable?
Acht u een geschillenregeling voor geschillen tussen landen onderling wenselijk?

Asks why a non-binding opinion from which the Rijksministerraad can deviate was chosen rather than a binding independent ruling, and which weighty grounds could justify departure; suggests a separate body.
Why was a non-binding opinion chosen from which departure is possible on weighty grounds?
Waarom is gekozen voor een niet-bindend oordeel waarvan op zwaarwegende gronden kan worden afgeweken?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised proceeding with the draft Kingdom Disputes Act (Rijkswet Koninkrijksgeschillen) but flagged weight of the Raad's opinion, scope of the dispute regime, the need for an evaluation clause and clarity on assessment criteria and Governor instructions. The government's reply accepted the evaluation clause, strengthened the binding weight standard to 'zwaarwegende gronden', narrowed the regime to purely legal disputes, deleted the assessment criteria article and clarified the Governor-instruction boundary.
concerns: Scope of the regime covering political-administrative disputes was questioned; the government narrowed it to purely legal disputes, while keeping the Raad advisory rather than binding.
The Afdeling found the weight of the Raad's opinion too weak; the government adopted a 'zwaarwegende gronden' standard rather than the 'zeer zwaarwegende gronden' the Afdeling proposed.
Article 6 on assessment criteria was ambiguous and was deleted as the Afdeling recommended.
Unclear boundary between Governor-instruction disputes and the Reglement procedures was clarified in the explanatory memorandum.
Term 'voorgenomen voorziening' was replaced by 'voorgenomen beslissing' as recommended.
Afdeling recommended an evaluation clause; government added one to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35570-VIII.s: The bill formally fixes the 2021 departmental budget statements for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the Ministry for Primary and Secondary Education and Media, together with the budget statements for the agencies DUO and Nationaal Archief, in thousands of euros. The accompanying explanatory extract describes policy priorities, budget tables, subsidies and the basis for lump-sum and subsidy financing without shifting statutory powers.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this law for the year 2021 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2021 draft budget bill for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes that no reply is needed for this budget bill, and that the one non-blank advice concerned the Ministry of Finance budget.

35975-VII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budgets of its executive agencies, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers, and no oversight changes.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36017-(R2159).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2021 maritime delimitation treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Dominican Republic, which sets the boundary between the exclusive economic zones of Aruba and Curaçao and the Dominican Republic. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The treaty solely determines the maritime delimitation between states.
Het verdrag bepaalt namelijk uitsluitend de maritieme afbakening tussen staten.

parties: Asks the government about the reasons for the treaty, the involvement of Aruba and Curaçao in negotiations, and its concrete effects on fisheries, environment and marine research.
The CDA members have noted with approval the present bill concerning the approval of the treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Dominican Republic on maritime delimitation.

De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetvoorstel inzake de goedkeuring van het verdrag tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Dominicaanse Republiek inzake maritieme afbakening.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the draft Kingdom Act approving the maritime delimitation treaty with the Dominican Republic gives no reason for substantive remarks, only redactional comments, and suggested publication. The minister's reply states all redactional comments were followed and explains the boundary alignment choice with Venezuela, which yields about 35 km2 less sea area but aligns Kingdom borders.
concerns: Redactional comments on the explanatory note, Dutch terminology (recht van de zee vs zeerecht) and the Spanish treaty title were all adopted.

36120-XIX.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the National Growth Fund (XIX), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across knowledge development, R&D and infrastructure, with a budget shift of minus 3.5 billion euro in commitments. The explanatory memorandum describes projects such as digitalisation of higher and vocational education and regional low-educated learning collectives, but the text contains no delegation of rule-making power or changes to oversight.

36360-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and the budget statement for its agencies, adjusting appropriations and realisation figures in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force of the Slotwet as the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The budget statements are established in thousands of euros.
De vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten geschiedt in duizenden euro's.

36410-XIV.s: This bill sets the Dutch state budget (departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality for 2024, agency budgets for the NVWA, and the Animal Health Fund) in thousands of euros. It mainly fixes budget amounts and entry into force, with the explanatory memorandum describing policy priorities on agriculture, nature, animal welfare, and inspection.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this law for the year 2023 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion on 11 September 2023 on the draft 2024 budget act for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) and the Animal Health Fund (F), finding no remarks on the proposal. The opinion was submitted with the Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 18 September 2023, which contains no substantive reply because no remarks were made.

36410-XVI.s: This bill sets the 2024 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, with spending of about 35.3 billion euros, and the budget statements for its baten-lastenagentschappen (CBG, CIBG, RIVM). The accompanying explanatory memorandum covers policy programmes, guarantees, budgetary effects and operational budgets but does not itself delegate rule-making or shift powers away from checks.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2024 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued no remarks on the draft 2024 budget bill (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The text consists of the advisory opinion and a cover note listing the advice for all budget chapters, with no separate government reply on substantive objections.

36470-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (second supplementary budget) and the 2023 budget statement of agency DUO, adjusting appropriations, revenues and investment figures in thousands of euros. It sets entry into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 24 November 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) and the budget statement for agency DUO, both for the year 2023.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) en de begrotingsstaat inzake agentschap DUO, alle voor het jaar 2023.

36560-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statements of the agencies DUO and the Nationaal Archief, as shown in the attached schedules. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that a need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII)

36647-(R2204).s: The bill modernises the Dutch Schepenwet (Ship Act) to match current practice and other maritime rules, updating terminology, certification, inspection powers and the handling of ships under detention. It adds administrative fines, a duty on shipowners to provide shore-side support, a new power for the Scheepvaartinspectie to investigate incidents, and removes the port state control provisions for Caribbean Netherlands and Dutch Europe.
36647-(R2204).j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by safety improvement and better enforcement, and says administrative fines and investigation powers will not significantly increase the inspectorate's workload.
q: This will lead to a better picture and greater awareness of important risks within the sector, so that accidents can be prevented.
Dit zal leiden tot een beter beeld en grotere bewustwording van belangrijke risico's binnen de sector, waardoor ongevallen kunnen worden voorkomen.
d: fixing the baseline line for leaving port at sea
categories of ships exempted from the Act
extending Act provisions to exempted ship categories in exceptional cases
safety requirements and crew standards (training, certification, medical fitness)
rules on recognition and designation of inspection organisations
shipowner duties on ship operations, implementing treaties and IMO decisions
procedure for investigating incidents involving ships
further rules implementing international/regional maritime decisions
p: Inspectors may detain ships for investigation under broadened grounds, with the detention decision formally motivated and subject to the General Administrative Law Act, though some appeal provisions are disapplied in the Netherlands.
The Scheepvaartinspectie gains a power to investigate incidents affecting ships, with the stated purpose limited to learning lessons and preventing accidents.
The inspectorate may impose administrative fines on shipowners for breaches of shore-support duties and prohibitions, with fixed fine ceilings by culpability.
An inspector may authorise temporary movement of a detained ship outside port on the harbour master's request, subject to radio contact.

parties: Asks how conflicts between owner and captain over obligations will be resolved and requests a comprehensive list of procedures, which implies a need for clear accountability.
These members ask what the procedure is once it becomes apparent in practice that the owner's and the captain's views on implementing the obligations conflict.
De leden vragen wat de procedure is zodra in de praktijk blijkt dat de opvatting van de eigenaar en de opvatting van de kapitein over de invulling van de verplichtingen conflicteren.
Doubts that the fine maximum of 22,500 euro is a deterrent for large operators and asks whether maximum amounts can be raised so that offending does not pay, noting courts can moderate fines.
These members would like to know whether it is possible to adjust the maximum fine amounts so that crime no longer pays.
Deze leden willen graag weten of het niet mogelijk is om de maximale boetebedragen zo aan te passen, dat misdaad niet meer loont.

Asks whether the OvV's decisions not to investigate accidents relate to lack of capacity and whether the Scheepvaartinspectie has sufficient capacity, and asks how HUF-toets enforcement criticism was addressed.
The NSC members ask to what extent OvV decisions to refrain from accident investigation are related to a lack of capacity.
De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen in hoeverre besluiten van de OvV om af te zien van ongevallenonderzoek gerelateerd zijn aan een gebrek aan capaciteit.
Praises the bill and asks only whether the future-proofing principle could apply to the captain nationality provision.
The CDA members express their appreciation for this bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie spreken hun waardering uit voor dit wetsvoorstel.

Asks whether the Maritime Authority Curaçao has the capacity to implement the changes, whether fines are proportionate for local small operators, and how cooperation among oversight bodies is guaranteed to avoid duplication.
Does the Maritime Authority Curaçao (MAC) have the capacity to implement these changes?
Heeft de Maritieme Autoriteit Curaçao (MAC) de capaciteit om uitvoering te geven aan deze wijzigingen?
Asks whether consultation rounds took place under Article 25 of the Statute and whether economic and financial consequences for Curaçao were considered, given the importance of the maritime sector.
Under Article 25 of the Statute, the fraction wishes to know whether there were consultation rounds.
In het kader van artikel 25 van het Statuut wenst de fractie te vernemen of er consultatierondes waren.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the draft Rijkswet amending the Schepenwet (modernisation of rules, obligations for ship owners, and an accident investigation possibility) raises no substantive remarks and should proceed to parliament and the Caribbean legislatures. The minister's nader rapport reports only redactional corrections and a restored exemption for ships registered on the BES islands, with no change in substance.
concerns: The Afdeling proposed redactional improvements to the bill and explanatory memorandum, which the government adopted.

36725-XV.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2025 departmental expenditure statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy articles such as labour market, benefits, childcare and the UWV implementation budget. It does not itself delegate rule-making or shift powers; it only changes budget figures and takes effect retroactively from 1 June 2025.
36725-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by revised cost estimates, court rulings and volume realisations, not by any new or delegated powers.
q: This is mainly because the level of uncollectable claims has been revised upward.
Dit komt voornamelijk doordat de hoogte van de oninbare vorderingen naar boven is bijgesteld.

36740-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statements for the agencies DUO and the Nationaal Archief, effective retroactively to 31 December of the budget year. It adjusts commitments, expenditure and revenue figures across policy articles and records the resulting realisation differences, without delegating rule-making power or altering oversight or judicial review.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII)
